title: Retro skill has no rule for a second retro on the same day
body:
What happened: The retro skill saves to .warden/retros/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md. A retro for the same date already existed (written earlier that day, with a second-pass section added by hand). Following the skill literally would overwrite it. The retro check also shows last = today and due = false, so nothing tells the user a retro file already exists.

Expected: the skill says what to do when the file exists, for example append a new pass section or add a suffix to the file name, and never overwrite.

Steps to repeat: run the retro skill twice on the same day, then save.

Evidence: skill step 5 says to save the retro as .warden/retros/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md, with no case for an existing file. retros/INDEX.md already lists 2026-10-18 as the first retro plus a second pass.
note: Fixed. A second retro on the same day adds a section.
